title: Marketing Dialectics Research Collection
scope: Curated Kantian dialectic, Kantian ethics, marketing research, industry cases, self-interest and institutional scrutiny, and Confucian ethics. Different translations and web records are distinct source records, not unique-work counts. Not an exhaustive bibliography.

resources.title: Critique of Pure Reason
resources.version: J. M. D. Meiklejohn translation (1855)
resources.reading_scope: Dialectic introduction, third antinomy, and appendix on regulative reason
resources.html_title: The Critique of Pure Reason | Project Gutenberg
resources.teaching_use: Reason seeks an unconditioned explanation; critique examines the resulting illusion and the limits of theoretical cognition. Use the original argument to distinguish Kantian dialectic from ordinary disagreement.

resources.title: Prolegomena to Any Future Metaphysics
resources.version: Paul Carus translation; edition recorded in downloaded title page
resources.teaching_use: A shorter route into the antinomies and the distinction between appearances and things in themselves. The mathematical and dynamical antinomies receive different resolutions.

resources.title: Fundamental Principles of the Metaphysic of Morals
resources.version: Thomas Kingsmill Abbott translation; Groundwork
resources.reading_scope: Second section: universal law, humanity, autonomy
resources.html_title: Fundamental Principles of the Metaphysic Of Morals | Project Gutenberg
resources.teaching_use: The Groundwork supplies the ethical principles used to assess the treatment of customers. Keep practical ethics distinct from the first Critique’s critique of metaphysics.

resources.title: Critique of Practical Reason
resources.version: Thomas Kingsmill Abbott translation
resources.reading_scope: Book II, chapter II, antinomy and critical solution
resources.html_title: The Critique of Practical Reason, by Immanuel Kant
resources.teaching_use: Examines the highest good and the relation between virtue and happiness. Avoid inferring a guarantee that ethical businesses earn higher profits.

resources.title: Critique of Judgement
resources.version: J. H. Bernard translation; second edition 1914
resources.reading_scope: Sections 40 and 55–57; contents for teleological dialectic
resources.html_title: The Project Gutenberg eBook of Kant’s Critique of Judgement, by J. H. Bernard.
resources.teaching_use: Adds independent thinking, the standpoint of others, and the antinomy of taste. A preference survey is a different object from Kant’s aesthetic judgment.

resources.title: Critique of Pure Reason: Transcendental Dialectic
resources.version: Modern English adaptation, not a literal translation
resources.teaching_use: Accessible modern adaptation of the Dialectic. Editorial additions and modernization distinguish it from a literal translation; compare with K01.

resources.title: Selections on Enlightenment and Independent Thought
resources.version: Two-page teaching compilation with extracts from several Kant works; translator not specified.
resources.teaching_use: Selections on enlightenment, public criticism, and independent thought from several Kant works. This is a compilation of extracts, not the complete Enlightenment essay.

resources.title: Kant's Critique of Metaphysics
resources.version: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy; revision September 14, 2022
resources.html_title: Kant’s Critique of Metaphysics (Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy)
resources.teaching_use: Interpretive guide to transcendental illusion, antinomies, and the positive role of systematic inquiry. Bibliography provides a route to deeper specialist scholarship.

resources.title: Kant's Transcendental Idealism
resources.version: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy; live edition at retrieval
resources.html_title: Kant’s Transcendental Idealism (Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy)
resources.teaching_use: Explains why the relation between appearances and things in themselves admits competing readings. This disagreement constrains a simplified account of the third antinomy.

resources.title: Kant's Moral Philosophy
resources.version: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy; revision October 2, 2025
resources.html_title: Kant’s Moral Philosophy (Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy)
resources.teaching_use: Clarifies rational self-legislation and the categorical imperative. A click, current preference, or consent form does not exhaust the philosophical concept of autonomy.

resources.title: Hegel's Dialectics
resources.version: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy; live edition at retrieval
resources.reading_scope: Introduction and discussion of the three-step interpretation
resources.teaching_use: Context for distinguishing Kant’s critique from later dialectics. Avoid attributing a universal thesis–antithesis–synthesis recipe to either tradition.

resources.title: Kant on the Status of Ideas and Principles of Reason
resources.version: Open Philosophy 5:296–307; DOI 10.1515/opphil-2022-0202
resources.rights: CC BY 4.0; copyright Gabriele Gava 2022; unchanged publisher PDF
resources.reading_scope: Abstract, introduction, and argument on differing regulative assumptions
resources.teaching_use: Examines disagreement over the status of regulative ideas. The article challenges the assumption that all such ideas have the same status. Useful for separating an inquiry-guiding ideal from an established empirical finding.

resources.title: Kant's Doctrine of Transcendental Illusion
resources.version: Official publisher excerpt; not the complete book
resources.reading_scope: Publisher excerpt viewed online, opening pages; local download unavailable
resources.error: 503 Server Error: Service Unavailable: Back-end server is at capacity for url: https://assets.cambridge.org/97805210/39727/excerpt/9780521039727_excerpt.pdf
resources.teaching_use: Major monograph on transcendental illusion. Full book not obtained. The publisher’s introduction can orient further reading; do not treat it as a complete-book review.

resources.title: Kant on the Sources of Metaphysics: The Dialectic of Pure Reason
resources.version: Official publisher front matter; not the complete book
resources.reading_scope: Publisher front matter viewed online; local download unavailable
resources.error: 503 Server Error: Service Unavailable: Back-end server is at capacity for url: https://assets.cambridge.org/97811084/72630/frontmatter/9781108472630_frontmatter.pdf
resources.teaching_use: Major monograph on reason’s demand for the unconditioned. Full book not obtained. Publisher description and contents identify its scope, not the details of its argument.

resources.title: Kant's Dialectic
resources.version: Official publisher front matter of 2016 reissue; not the complete book
resources.reading_scope: Publisher front matter viewed online; local download unavailable
resources.error: 503 Server Error: Service Unavailable: Back-end server is at capacity for url: https://assets.cambridge.org/97811071/40578/frontmatter/9781107140578_frontmatter.pdf
resources.teaching_use: Book-length study of Kant’s Dialectic, originally published in 1974. The 2016 reissue front matter identifies the edition; the full text has not been obtained.

resources.title: The Nature of Human Reason: Willaschek on Kant on the Rational Sources of Metaphysics
resources.version: Author abstract; Studi Kantiani 33:127–139; DOI 10.19272/202002901009
resources.html_title: The Nature of Human Reason: Willaschek on Kant on the Rational Sources of Metaphysics - Katharina T. Kraus
resources.teaching_use: Discussion of Willaschek’s reconstruction of the rational sources of metaphysics. Full article not obtained; use as a bibliographic lead.

resources.title: The Market in the Kingdom of Ends: Kant’s Moral Philosophy for Business Ethics
resources.version: Philosophy of Management 23:239–256; DOI 10.1007/s40926-024-00252-z
resources.rights: Article CC BY 4.0; original website snapshot retained locally, including publisher navigation
resources.teaching_use: Defends a Kantian interpretation of mutually beneficial commercial exchange. Useful for evaluating a practice without assuming that a profit motive makes it intrinsically wrongful.

resources.title: Normative Perspectives for Ethical and Socially Responsible Marketing
resources.version: University-hosted accepted version; Journal of Macromarketing 26:154–177
resources.reading_scope: Opening framework and selected normative perspectives
resources.teaching_use: Connects marketing conduct to customers, stakeholders, and the wider system of exchange. The university copy is an accepted manuscript and explicitly prohibits further redistribution without permission.

resources.title: The General Theory of Marketing Ethics: A Revision and Three Questions
resources.version: Journal of Macromarketing 26:143–153; DOI 10.1177/0276146706290923
resources.reading_scope: Publisher abstract only; file download blocked
resources.teaching_use: Describes and revisits an explanatory model of ethical decision making. A positive account of how judgments arise differs from a justification of what ought to be done.

resources.title: A Comparison of Approaches to Advertising Measurement: Evidence from Big Field Experiments at Facebook
resources.version: April 12, 2018 working paper; later published in Marketing Science (2019)
resources.teaching_use: Compares observational advertising estimates with randomized experiments in the studied campaigns. Distinguish selection from incremental response, then assess whether the chosen outcome answers the customer-benefit claim.

resources.title: Shining a Light on Dark Patterns
resources.version: August 5, 2019 working paper; later Journal of Legal Analysis 13:43–109 (2021)
resources.teaching_use: Experimental evidence that enrollment depends on the interface used to decline an offer. The retrieved file is the 2019 working paper, distinct from the 2021 journal article.

resources.title: Dark Patterns at Scale: Findings from a Crawl of 11K Shopping Websites
resources.version: arXiv author version retrieved November 6, 2026; ACM paper DOI 10.1145/3359183; saved-file checksum pins the copy
resources.teaching_use: Descriptive measurement of interface practices in a crawl of shopping websites. Website prevalence is a different estimand from a causal effect on customer welfare.

resources.title: Advertising and Behavior Control
resources.version: Journal of Business Ethics 1:3–12; DOI 10.1007/BF00382800
resources.teaching_use: Defends a more permissive assessment of advertising using distinctions among autonomy and control concepts. Pair with M08; full article is still needed for a detailed comparison.

resources.title: Persuasive Advertising, Autonomy, and the Creation of Desire
resources.version: Journal of Business Ethics 6:413–418; DOI 10.1007/BF00382898
resources.teaching_use: Challenges persuasive advertising that undermines autonomous choice, distinguishing it from informative advertising. Pair with M07; claims here are limited to the abstract.

resources.title: Statement of Ethics
resources.version: Live professional statement at retrieval; aspirational, not legislation
resources.teaching_use: Professional statement with aspirational commitments. It informs discussion of responsibilities but is neither legislation nor an enforcement decision.

resources.title: Bringing Dark Patterns to Light
resources.version: September 2022 staff report
resources.teaching_use: Historical FTC staff report on problematic interface practices. Its examples and taxonomy do not establish the current status of a particular cancellation rule.

resources.title: About Conversion Lift
resources.version: Live product documentation at retrieval
resources.reading_scope: How it works and reported metrics
resources.html_title: About Conversion Lift - Google Ads Help
resources.teaching_use: Provider documentation on conversion-lift studies. Distinguish product description from independent validation of a particular implementation.

resources.title: Artwork Personalization at Netflix
resources.version: Netflix Technology Blog, December 7, 2017
resources.teaching_use: Company account of tailoring artwork to help members discover content. Useful for separating presentation, behavior, and the customer’s considered purpose.

resources.title: ASA Ruling on Shell UK Ltd t/a Shell
resources.version: June 7, 2023; upheld in part; UK advertising decision
resources.reading_scope: Both issue outcomes and environmental assessment
resources.teaching_use: UK ASA ruling of June 7, 2023, upheld in part. Material omitted context affected the overall environmental impression; a separate renewable-electricity issue was not upheld.

resources.title: ASA Ruling on Shell UK Ltd
resources.version: April 9, 2025; not upheld; UK advertising decision
resources.teaching_use: UK ASA ruling of April 9, 2025, not upheld. The advertisement’s broader context and qualifying information differed. The ruling explains which version of the code it applied.

resources.title: An Answer to the Question: What Is Enlightenment?
resources.version: Three-page university-hosted teaching translation; translator not identified
resources.reading_scope: Opening paragraphs and public/private reason distinction
resources.teaching_use: Independent judgment and public examination of claims motivate source checking in AI-assisted work. Read its political context rather than equating its terms with modern data privacy.

resources.title: Kant’s Transcendental Idealism: An Interpretation and Defense
resources.version: Second edition; publisher metadata only
resources.teaching_use: Revised and enlarged study of transcendental idealism. Full book not obtained. Consult S02 for an accessible account of interpretive disagreements.

resources.title: Business Ethics: A Kantian Perspective
resources.version: Second edition; publisher metadata only
resources.reading_scope: Publisher metadata and chapter listing only
resources.teaching_use: A systematic Kantian business-ethics treatment. The full second edition has not been obtained; record it as further reading rather than a downloaded book.

resources.title: Of the Independency of Parliament
resources.version: Hume Texts Online; final lifetime text, paragraphs 1–3 central
resources.reading_scope: Paragraphs 1–3, checked against full essay context
resources.teaching_use: Institutional safeguards should work under pursuit of private interests. Hume explicitly distinguishes a design maxim from a factual claim that every person is dishonest.

resources.title: An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations
resources.version: Public-domain edition; Book I, chapter XI, concluding discussion
resources.reading_scope: Book I, chapter XI, concluding paragraphs
resources.html_title: The Wealth of Nations | Project Gutenberg
resources.teaching_use: Smith urges scrutiny of commercial-regulation proposals from interested merchants and manufacturers. Applying that reasoning to product claims is a contemporary extension of its original scope.

resources.title: The Analects of Confucius
resources.version: James Legge translation; public-domain edition
resources.reading_scope: Analects 2.15, 4.5, 4.16, 12.7, 13.3, 13.23, 14.22, 15.24; modern numbering compared with C02
resources.teaching_use: Righteousness, trustworthiness, fitting conduct, truthful challenge, reciprocity, and reflective learning inform the marketing applications. Section numbering can differ between editions; consult the passage as well as its number.

resources.title: The Analects of Confucius: An Online Teaching Translation
authors: translated and annotated by Robert Eno
resources.version: University-hosted teaching translation; compare with Legge
resources.reading_scope: Introduction and selected passages listed under C01
resources.teaching_use: Annotated modern teaching translation. Compare wording and explanatory notes with Legge’s historical translation; translation and commentary are distinct from the original text.

resources.title: Mencius: An Online Teaching Translation
authors: translated and annotated by Robert Eno
resources.version: University-hosted teaching translation
resources.teaching_use: The opening challenges an exclusive focus on advantage; the account of moral beginnings emphasizes cultivable capacities. These political and ethical arguments require explicit interpretation when applied to firms.

resources.title: Selection from the Xunzi: Human Nature Is Evil
resources.version: Excerpt from Sources of Chinese Tradition, compiled by Wm. Theodore de Bary and Irene Bloom, 2nd edition, volume 1 (1999), pp. 179–183
resources.teaching_use: Unchecked desires and deliberate cultivation are central to Xunzi’s argument. Good conduct requires learning and patterned practice; this does not establish guilt in each particular transaction.

resources.title: Confucius
resources.version: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy; live edition, copyright 2024
resources.teaching_use: Scholarly context for the historical texts and interpretive diversity. Avoid treating an entire tradition as a fixed management checklist.

resources.title: Xunzi
resources.version: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy; live edition, copyright 2025
resources.teaching_use: Clarifies Xunzi’s account and disagreements with Mencius, including differences in what human nature denotes. Moral cultivation remains possible and consequential.
